name: Nitrokey App2
blurb: Nitrokey 3 is an advanced open source/open hardware USB key supporting FIDO2, an OpenPGP Card, PIV and a Password-Safe including OTPs.
description:
Nitrokey 3 is an advanced open source/open hardware USB key supporting FIDO2, an OpenPGP Card, PIV and a Password-Safe including OTPs.
This package contains the new Nitrokey-App2, which allows accessing, updating and managing Nitrokey 3 devices.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
